name: io.github.alimohammadiamirhossein/deputy
title: Deputy
description: Claude Code helper: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reviews Claude's code for bugs and gives second opinions

environmentVariables.name: DEEPINFRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DeepInfra API key (deepinfra.com, Dashboard > API Keys). Or set DEPUTY_API_KEY for another OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: accuracy: Claude writes all code; Deputy reviews and consults. lean: fewest Claude tokens, little accuracy loss. balanced: Deputy takes mechanical work. partner: Deputy does all low-level work and gives ideas. savings: Deputy takes most coding.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_THINKING
environmentVariables.description: How hard the helper model thinks.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id served by the endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https, or http on localhost for a local model).

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Project folder Deputy may read and edit. Defaults to the client's project folder.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for a non-DeepInfra endpoint. Takes precedence over DEEPINFRA_API_KEY.
